text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I invite Tazuna to go see a movie since I
happen
to have a discount coupon for
the theater.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the theater to find Tazuna
overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Did you know the movie theater just
underwent a
large-scale renovation?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The sound system got major improvements! It seems they were handing out coupons to celebrate the grand reopening.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The gigantic screen and booming sound
are the
best parts of going to the
movies, don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I sure do! ♪
choice_data_list: 映画、お好きだったんですね

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, we haven't decided
on which
movie to see yet!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any specific genre
preferences, so
anything would be great!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, that spy movie! Yeah, that
sounds
exciting!
choice_data_list: 『白球ひと筋、空へ――熱血野球部物語！』

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There's something kind of appealing
about
leading a secret double life like
that. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my. Sorry, but do you mind if I go
buy a
towel?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Well... You see...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to cry during this
one! A
handkerchief won't be enough!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And so Tazuna and I enjoy a movie
together.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that was so fun! Thanks so much
for inviting
me today!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I've been so busy lately that I haven't
been able
to go to the movies, so I was
really happy to step
back into the world
of cinema today! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I do! The movies themselves are great, of
course,
but I—how should I put this? I
really love movie
theaters!
choice_data_list: 本当に好きなんですね、映画

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
With smartphones and the internet, it's
easy to
watch movies anywhere, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Riding the train, walking to the theater,
picking
out your seat, watching the
trailers, and waiting
for the main
feature...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I can't get enough of that feeling of
anticipation!
It's like waiting for the
starting gates to open! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Uh, what I mean is...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh! This is our stop!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is where we must part! Be
careful on the
way home!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Tazuna leaves, I look up at the
digital
billboard in front of the station.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"She made her mark, but then left the
racing
world forever... Yet her legend
has endured
through the ages..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "The Phantom Umamusume, returning soon to a theater near you!"
